messages:
Tara (Partnerships): Quick note: VectorCloud's marketplace adapter fails on our new auth header name. They need a short compatibility lane and a CI snippet. Can we do a fast follow?
Ben (Eng): If they just validate header names, we can emit both headers for their requests for a short window. Minimal code change at the edge.
Kai (Eng-Platform): I'll add a per-partner flag 'vectorcloud-dual-headers' and a smoke endpoint /compat/vectorcloud/ping that returns sample responses.
Lena (PM): They want a 10-day runway and a curl test to drop into nightly CI. Also need a clear sunset date in comms.
Ben (Eng): I'll add telemetry counts: vectorcloud.headers.old_only, new_only, dual. Also a private gist with a Node and curl example.
deploy-bot: feature-flag 'vectorcloud-dual-headers' scheduled for canary 2025-11-12T05:00Z. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/5012
Tara (Partnerships): Perfect. Action items: kai add flag+endpoint, ben add dual-emit and gist, lena ship comms with dates. I'll send the partner the harness once canary is green. :thumbsup:
